internal_policy.discard: Ordinary IF_AVAILABLE friendly other HAND card of all playable types. Each actual successful DiscardRecord is linked to originally captured native Deathrattle abilities before discard listeners/own-discard body capture. Stale physical target creates neither discard nor memory.
internal_policy.memory: Native discard_link stores only ordered immutable actual discard IDs; existing record also freezes minimal printed base components/Jade identity. Current copy carries memory independently; base copy, reset, silence and transform follow ordinary native attachment policies. No scanning source-ID history or player memo map.
internal_policy.recovery: Actual native Deathrattle frozen memory resolves each original DiscardRecord through shared CopyCard(base,HAND), granting fresh local CostSpec(delta=-1) before acquisition notification. New base instance, components/innate printed identity retained, old local buffs/cost/injury/temporary hand lease not inherited. Current Deathrattle executor receives copy; original discarded physical entity can have moved without rebinding recipe. Exact server copy/return identity/material policy remains CN-uncalibrated.
internal_policy.multiple: Each successful repeated native body appends its own accepted occurrence to original ability only. Already accepted Deathrattle captures remain unchanged; same-ID new residence/removed native ability do not receive late links. Non-native special grants lacking original memory remain explicit unsupported.
